quests.title: Stories of the Past

dialogue.t: Many thanks for the invitation, Miss Guillotin. I presume this pure water was prepared specially for me?
Think nothing of it, Monsieur Neuvillette. It's an honor to have the Iudex of Fontaine take time out of his busy schedule to join me for a cup of... water.
Does the Fatui have some official business that you wish to discuss?
Not at all. This is a strictly personal visit. And there's no need to be so formal. I simply wanted to ask you about an old acquaintance.
An old acquaintance... Ah, you must be talking about Mr. Alain Guillotin? The great Lord-Artificer.
Exactly. What kind of person was he? I heard he was your subordinate in his youth.
Hmm...
Mr. Guillotin was an earnest and grounded young man. Even after being granted the title of White Cavalier of Protection, he never exhibited one iota of arrogance.
He spent most of his time studying machines. The world outside his own little bubble was of little interest to him.
Huh... So he was like that even when he was younger? I wonder if he was wise beyond his years or simply ignorant of the ways of the world.
However... He changed dramatically after losing his family and friends.
The Tower of Gestalt? And Elynas...
Indeed. When he and I signed the order to search the tower, he appeared... helpless.
It was the estrangement and alienation of the past that led to all that. He must have felt guilty, too.
Hmm... He became even more taciturn after that, and our interactions grew less frequent.
At the ceremony where he was given the title of Lord-Artificer, all he said was the following:
"A quiet, humble life is a surer path to happiness than the blind pursuit of endless perfection."
Heh... And that's exactly how he lived in his later years.
I guess he wasn't just saying that to the crowd. He was saying it to himself.
And what do you think about it all, Miss Guillotin?
Me? Hmph. I won't pass judgment on his epiphany or his way of life, just as he never told me how I should live my own.
But I have no intention of either following his path or of imitating his ideals. I'm my own person.
Heh... Thank you. You've helped me understand him better.
You're very welcome. It's a pleasure to share stories of the past with one of his family.
And a pleasure to share stories of the past with you, Miss Guillotin, over this wonderful glass of water.

dialogue.sit: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)
I think it's time I started clearing up.

dialogue.t: Very well. Wherever you're going next, I wish you a smooth journey.

quests.description: Go to Palais Mermonia, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Neuvillette…
